THE FIVE HIGH-RISK STEPS, TOGETHER if only five things get fixed before user testing, these are them
1 · Composer, seven fields
The single largest abandonment risk in the product. A structured form asking for conditions is objectively more work than a text box, and the payoff is invisible until an answer arrives.
2 · Deposit step 3, metadata
Testers named the old upload as the worst screen. Stating requirements up front helps, but this is still where a 2 GB upload meets a form.
3 · Null result, "what it rules out"
The field that makes the object reusable is also the one requiring the most thought, at the end of a form, about work that failed.
4 · Search → do anything
Roughly 55% of people who find a relevant person take no action. Every route on screen 6 attacks this one bar.
5 · Handover pack, the six blanks
94% compiles automatically; the last 6% needs a departing person's attention in their final week, which is when they have least of it.
